parameters.content:
# OrbitPage Smart Bio · YouTube

New public video → native YouTube player. No YouTube key and no AI charges.

1. Install n8n-nodes-orbitpage ≥0.3.2.
2. Select one OrbitPage credential on every OrbitPage node. Scopes: workspace:read, links:read, links:write, publication:read, publication:write.
3. Set the UC channel ID in Configuration.
4. Choose AUTOMATIC or EMAIL_APPROVAL. For approval, select SMTP and set sender/recipient.
5. The registry is created automatically. Use a dedicated table name for each workflow/workspace.
6. First normal run records a baseline without importing old videos. To test an existing video, set MANUAL_VIDEO_ID and run the manual trigger.
7. Clear MANUAL_VIDEO_ID after testing, then publish the schedule.

Titles/descriptions are optional. The native player remains gated by the page consent settings. Never run overlapping manual replays against the scheduled workflow.

## 1 · Feed and persistent registry

Public Atom feed; channel and video IDs are validated. One new video per poll, oldest first. The first poll records current IDs. Processing/pending/declined/expired/published rows prevent repeat cards and repeat requests.

A processing row after an error is intentionally held for review. Inspect the execution and current card before clearing only that row. Do not reset the whole table.

## 2 · Save only the requested card

Preserve all existing blocks. EMAIL_APPROVAL uses the public API publish=0 option to save a private draft. AUTOMATIC saves a live card immediately. Both modes check revisions and refuse to release unrelated private drafts.

Approval is bound to the exact staged revision. A stable smartbio-VIDEO_ID makes retries identifiable. Requires an OrbitPage API version exposing publish=0 on PUT /links.

## 3 · Email decision → exact card → live check

Approva e pubblica / Rifiuta. Default timeout: 48 hours. Rejection or timeout discards only the unchanged proposed card, republishing the prior content; no repeat request. Concurrent changes stop automatic cleanup for manual review.

Before publishing, re-read the card and compare the exact draft revision and content. Stale writes stop; no blind publication retry. Finally check publication metadata and the expected card in public HTML. This is an HTTP smoke check; video playback can still be restricted by YouTube.
